_schema: LIHTC maximum rents by AMI band for restricted NOI used only to size a recast or 0% recap gap on our_book rows. PLACEHOLDER: every rent is null until the user pastes the current HUD/OHCS limits; while null, est_restricted_noi is blank and the lead carries 'Missing Source — Request Document' (rent roll from the agency file); there is no market $/unit fallback. Populate from the <state HFA> rent-limits page (MTSP limits, <metro FMR area>) and record as_of and source.
source: <state HFA> MTSP income and rent limits for <metro FMR area>; URL to be confirmed
unit_mix_assumption: rents are blended across bedroom sizes; when the property's unit mix is known, replace with a weighted figure per band
notes: Gross rent limits include a utility allowance; net the allowance before using as collectable rent.
HOME and OAHTC rents can be lower than the LIHTC limit for the same AMI band; use the binding restriction.
Market-rate units in a mixed property are descriptive only; no market rent is applied.
